title: Duplicate Saito Positivity Conjecture
statement: Prove or disprove K. Saito's positivity conjecture for the relevant eta products when h is divisible by at least two distinct primes.
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Gitter und Anwendungen (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/01, pp. 5--67](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2005/01)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The primary report states that the case with at least two distinct prime divisors has no general answer, with only affirmative examples; no later general solution was located.

**Sources checked.**
